lines.en: The heavy chains make my walk slow.
The shackles clink with each step.

lines.zh: 石墙间徘徊，脚步声回响。
lines.en: I walk between stone walls, my footsteps echo.
Metal shackles bind my freedom.

lines.zh: 狱墙阴影，守护阴森之路。
lines.en: Shadowy walls guard the grim path.
My chains drag on the ground as I walk.

lines.zh: 目光如炬，警惕着每一个角落。
lines.en: My gaze is a burning torch, watching every corner.
A prisoner, yet still I must guard.
Each step is my duty.
Shackled, I remain vigilant.

lines.zh: 我拖着脚镣绕牢房一圈。
lines.en: I drag my shackles once around the cell block.
I check the cell doors one by one.

lines.zh: 铁栅的影子在我脸上划过。
lines.en: Bar shadows slide across my face.
Patrol, from the east corridor to the west.
I stand still in the prison.
I watch the surroundings with suspicion.
Shackled, I stand still.
I quietly guard in the depths of the prison.
I stand, my gaze a burning torch.
Bound by chains, I guard peace.

lines.zh: 铁链如锁，锁住我的自由。
lines.en: Chains lock my freedom.
Though a prisoner, I still must guard.
Bound by chains, I guard justice.

lines.zh: 靠在栅栏上，听远处的锁声。
lines.en: Leaning on the bars, listening to distant chains.

lines.zh: 把薙刀横在膝上，歇一会。
lines.en: I lay the naginata across my knees and rest.
I count the breaths in the cells.

lines.zh: 铁镣磨着脚踝，早没知觉。
lines.en: The shackle rubs my ankle; I stopped feeling it.

lines.zh: 火把快灭了，我守着余光。
lines.en: The torch is dying; I watch by its last light.

lines.zh: 你闯入了不该进入的地方。
lines.en: You've entered forbidden grounds.
My gaze locks onto you.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动都在我的监视中。
lines.en: Your every move is under my watch.

lines.zh: 囚徒虽困，但不会放任你。
lines.en: Bound as I am, I won't let you go easily.

lines.zh: 你动弹不得，已被我锁住。
lines.en: You cannot move, you are locked here.

lines.zh: 你触碰了我的领地，付出代价。
lines.en: You have trespassed, pay the price.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动，尽在监控之中。
lines.en: Your actions are under surveillance.

lines.zh: 你闯入异端监狱，必然受罚。
lines.en: Your entry into the heretic prison will be punished.
Your actions anger me.
You are immobilized, controlled.
Your steps don't fit prison rules.
No wandering on this cell level.
I know every prisoner's face.

lines.zh: 举起手，让我数你的指头。
lines.en: Hands up. Let me count your fingers.
Where are your shackles?
A dead man's duty is still a duty.

lines.zh: 别摸墙，那是囚徒的记号。
lines.en: Don't touch the wall; those are prisoners' marks.
I've had my eye on you for three paces.

lines.zh: 这里没有出口，只有规矩。
lines.en: There is no exit here, only rules.
The chains loosen, but my duty remains.
This pain reminds me not to slacken.

lines.zh: 伤了，但不能退，继续看守！
lines.en: Injured, but must keep watch.
Chains broken, duty remains.

lines.zh: 伤痕累累，我却不可倒下！
lines.en: Wounded, but I cannot falter.
Bound by chains, yet must endure.

lines.zh: 枷锁松了，但心牢不可破！
lines.en: The chains loosen, but the heart remains firm.
Prison broken, but duty unbroken.
Injured, but the mission calls.
Even dead, I finish my shift.
You have food?
You cannot have these keys.
I must guard here!
Your food can tempt me?

lines.zh: 你有可以交换的东西吗？
lines.en: Do you have something to trade?
I won't trust anyone.
The prison is the only way out.
Don't think I'll let you out.
I've guarded here for a long time.
I've been imprisoned here too long.
I'm still on duty behind the cell door.
Move, move!

lines.zh: 囚笼似的头盔撞在你胸口。
lines.en: My cage-like helmet hits your chest.
You bumped into a warden's armor.
I can't give way!
Do not touch this old armor.
You can't disrupt my patrol.
The cell door is that way; move.
My shackles still clink. Don't be afraid.
Let's coexist peacefully.

lines.zh: 死了也还是这座监狱的守卫。
lines.en: Dead or not, I still guard this prison.
I will share half my chain with you.
In this prison, there are only us two.
Even the dead want company.
We are heretics.

lines.zh: 我也是囚犯，只是还站着岗。
lines.en: I'm a prisoner too. I just keep the watch.
Stay with me until the watch changes.
However cold this cell, you have me.
We fight together.
I'm a prisoner myself.

lines.zh: 我感到饥渴，但这并不属于我。
lines.en: I feel hungry, but this is not mine.

lines.zh: 你来得太晚了，无法带走我的责任。
lines.en: You came too late to relieve me of my duty.

lines.zh: 我的职责永不止息，即使在死后。
lines.en: My duty never ends, not even in death.

lines.zh: 我本为囚徒，却成为了守卫。
lines.en: I was a prisoner, now I guard.

lines.zh: 这里是我永远的家，也是我的地狱。
lines.en: This is my eternal home, and my hell.

lines.zh: 我不会轻易让位给新来的。
lines.en: I won't easily make way for newcomers.

lines.zh: 我的刀刃渴望着解脱，但我不能。
lines.en: My blade longs for release, but I cannot.

lines.zh: 即使在死神面前，我也不会退缩。
lines.en: Even before death, I will not retreat.

lines.zh: 你必须面对你的罪行，就像我一样。
lines.en: You must face your sins, like me.

lines.zh: 我守护着这里，直到最后一刻。
lines.en: I guard here until my last moment.
One step past the line and my chain follows.
I will oversee your actions.
Prepare to face judgment.
At the end of the corridor, it is still me.

lines.zh: 我会盯着你，直到你消失。
lines.en: I will stare you down until you vanish.
You will bear my scrutiny.
You dare not defy my will.

lines.zh: 我会紧盯着你，直到你崩溃。
lines.en: I will keep a close eye on you until you break.

lines.zh: 你的行动在我的观察之下。
lines.en: Your actions are under my observation.
You won't escape my gaze.

lines.zh: 我要盯着你，直到你失去踪迹。
lines.en: I will stare you down until you vanish.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动都在我的监视之中。
lines.en: Your every move is within my watch.

lines.zh: 我的目光将锁定你，直到你崩溃。
lines.en: My gaze will fix on you until you break.

lines.zh: 你的位置已被标记，你无处可逃。
lines.en: Your position has been marked; you have nowhere to go.

lines.zh: 我会盯着你看，直到你屈服。
lines.en: I will stare you down until you submit.

lines.zh: 我的目光不会让你有丝毫放松。
lines.en: My gaze will not allow you any respite.

lines.zh: 你动弹不得，只能听命于我。
lines.en: You cannot move, only obey me.

lines.zh: 我的目光将穿透你的防御。
lines.en: My gaze will pierce your defenses.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动都在我的监控之下。
lines.en: Your every action is under my surveillance.

lines.zh: 我的视线不会让你逃脱。
lines.en: My line of sight will not allow you to escape.
Sssss, outcast!
You’ve broken the code!
Your fate is unbreakable!
Death is the only release!
Obey or be punished!
Lay down your arms, surrender!
You belong in darkness, not light!
My naginata sweeps; get back.
Submit, or you’ll regret it!
You cannot defy fate!
Be wary, prisoner!
Heretic about to sleep!
New guard is awakening!
Dark eyes are watching you!
Prison is your eternal home!
You can’t escape, forever!
Follow the rules, or suffer!
Your soul will eventually extinguish!
Chains rattle — you're a prisoner again.
Darkness rules all!
Below the cell door, I stand up again.

lines.zh: 监狱深处，铁链响了一声。
lines.en: Deep in the prison, a chain clinks once.

lines.zh: 火焰烧灼，我的誓言永不变！
lines.en: Fire burns, but my vow remains.

lines.zh: 跌落谷底，我的使命仍在！
lines.en: Fell to my doom, but my duty remains.
Drowned, but my duty remains.
Explosion injures me, but my duty remains.

lines.zh: 箭矢射穿我，但看守不能停！
lines.en: Arrows pierce me, but the watch must continue.
Magic wounds me, but my duty remains.
Starvation hard, but I must hold on.
Lightning strikes, but my duty remains.
Fell into the void, but my duty remains.
